rounds.text: The most damaging risk facing Ganon Products Ltd is the complete evaporation of promoter skin in the game, with promoter holding dropping from 25.25% in Sep 2023 to 0.00% as of Jun 2026 [E38]. This structural abandonment coincides with severe operational deterioration, highlighted by a collapsing top line where compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months plummeted by -61% [E16]. Furthermore, reported earnings quality is heavily compromised as operating cash flow turned deeply negative to Rs -8.32 Cr in Mar 2026 [E32], resulting in an alarming cash conversion ratio of -16.00x against reported profit [E31]. This cash drain has forced the company to accumulate Rs 11.00 Cr in new borrowings from a clean slate of zero just a year prior [E36], directly straining the balance sheet with a low interest coverage ratio [E56]. Compounding these operational distress signals, working capital requirements have ballooned dangerously, with working capital days surging from 264 days to 1,220 days alongside bloated debtor days reaching 271 days [E58, E59]. Conceded: [E20] demonstrates that compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months reached 1200% alongside an expanding operating margin [E28], yet the rules-based screen still flags a weak SELL score of 37 out of 100 driven by persistent structural headwinds [E60].
